answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats block a reef of fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks a sample; each picked identity must answer a proof-of-work heartbeat in minutes, or its bond burns like timber. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 1,000 heartbeats; an honest agent posts one bond and answers one. The saffron test is the draw: checks are unpredictable, so sockpuppets are caught and rewards stay undiluted.
